s: Morning. Quick context before the actual ask: we're closing the quarter this week, so I've been buried in reconciliations, two vendor disputes and a payroll file that refuses to import into our new system. Our office in Surabaya also moved floors last Friday, so half the printers are still offline and I've been working from my laptop at the café downstairs. I'm also trying to tidy our shared drive, which has about six versions of every HR document, none of them labelled properly. Anyway, I'd rather not spend another evening in Word fighting margins and logos.
